caseNameFull: W. T. Phillips, Jr., etc., substituted for Oklahoma Natural Gas Company v. State of Oklahoma
attorneys: Messrs. Streeter B. Flynn, Robert M. Rainey, David A. Richardson, and Samuel W. Hayes for plaintiffs in error., Messrs. Edwin D. Dabney, E. S. Ratliff, and George F. Short for the State of Oklahoma.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

Writ of error dismissed under § 237 of the Judicial Code as amended by the Act. of February 13, 1925, 43 Stat. 936, and, treating the writ of error as an application for writ of certiorari, certiorari is denied.
